        "transactions.csv",
        "profiles.csv", 
        "activity.csv",
        "account_health.csv",
        "transactions_late.csv",
        "labels.csv"
    ]
    
    print("Uploading files to DBFS...")
    for filename in files_to_upload:
        local_path = os.path.join(local_data_path, filename)
        dbfs_dest = f"{dbfs_path}{filename}"

    print("\nCreating temporary tables...")
    
    # Create transactions table (combining transactions.csv and transactions_late.csv)

        f"""CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW temp_transactions AS

UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM csv.`{dbfs_path}transactions_late.csv`
"""
    )

    ws.sql.execute(f"CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW temp_account_health AS SELECT * FROM csv.`{dbfs_path}account_health.csv`")
    ws.sql.execute(f"CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW temp_labels AS SELECT * FROM csv.`{dbfs_path}labels.csv`")
    print("Created all temporary views")
    
    # Create the training dataset with time-based filtering

    # For each label, get the most recent feature values at or before label_time

  -- Get latest transaction features for each account at or before each label_time
  SELECT 
    l.account_id,
    l.label_time,
    l.churned,
    -- Latest amount and balance from transactions
    (SELECT t.amount FROM temp_transactions t 
     WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.event_time <= l.label_time
     ORDER BY t.event_time DESC LIMIT 1) as amount,
    (SELECT t.balance FROM temp_transactions t 
     WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.event_time <= l.label_time
     ORDER BY t.event_time DESC LIMIT 1) as balance,
    -- Latest credit_score and tier from profiles
    (SELECT p.credit_score FROM temp_profiles p 
     WHERE p.account_id = l.account_id AND p.event_time <= l.label_time
     ORDER BY p.event_time DESC LIMIT 1) as credit_score,
    (SELECT p.tier FROM temp_profiles p 
     WHERE p.account_id = l.account_id AND p.event_time <= l.label_time
     ORDER BY p.event_time DESC LIMIT 1) as tier,
    -- Latest sessions_7d from activity
    (SELECT a.sessions_7d FROM temp_activity a 
     WHERE a.account_id = l.account_id AND a.event_time <= l.label_time
     ORDER BY a.event_time DESC LIMIT 1) as sessions_7d,
    -- Latest health_score from account_health
    (SELECT h.health_score FROM temp_account_health h 
     WHERE h.account_id = l.account_id AND h.event_time <= l.label_time
     ORDER BY h.event_time DESC LIMIT 1) as health_score
  FROM temp_labels l

  account_id,
  label_time,
  amount,
  balance,
  credit_score,
  tier,
  sessions_7d,
  health_score,
  churned
FROM latest_features
